revenue_won.label: Sold
revenue_won.definition: Value of deals closed as won in the period.
revenue_won.formula: Σ value of deals in stage Won with close date in the period

invoiced.label: Invoiced
invoiced.definition: Total of invoices issued in the period.
invoiced.formula: Σ amount of invoices with issue date in the period

collected.label: Collected
collected.definition: Money that actually arrived in the bank for invoices in the period.
collected.formula: Σ amount of invoices with payment date in the period

receivables.label: Receivables
receivables.definition: Issued invoices that were still unpaid at the end of the period.
receivables.formula: Σ unpaid invoices at the end of the period

overdue.label: Overdue
overdue.definition: Unpaid invoices that are past their due date.
overdue.formula: Σ unpaid invoices with due date before the end of the period

dso.label: DSO
dso.definition: Average number of days from issuing an invoice to its payment.
dso.formula: average (payment date − issue date) for invoices paid in the period

pipeline.label: Pipeline
pipeline.definition: Total value of all open deals.

weighted_forecast.label: Weighted forecast
weighted_forecast.definition: Sales estimate for the period: what is already won plus open deals weighted by the probability of their stage.
weighted_forecast.formula: won in the period + Σ value × stage probability of open deals expected to close in the period

plan.label: Plan
plan.definition: Sales target for the selected team and period.
plan.formula: Σ monthly quota of reps × share of each month in the period

attainment.label: Plan attainment
attainment.definition: How much of the plan is already sold.

coverage.label: Pipeline coverage
coverage.definition: How many times the open pipeline closing in the period covers the part of the plan that is still missing.
coverage.formula: pipeline expected to close in the period / (Plan − Sold)

win_rate.label: Win rate
win_rate.definition: Share of won deals among all deals closed in the period.
win_rate.formula: won / (won + lost), closed in the period

cycle_days.label: Sales cycle
cycle_days.definition: Typical time from creating a deal to winning it.
cycle_days.formula: median days from creation to close for won deals

avg_deal.label: Average deal
avg_deal.definition: Average value of one won deal.

gross_margin.label: Gross margin
gross_margin.definition: How much of sales remains after direct costs (trainers, travel, materials).

activities_done.label: Activities done
activities_done.definition: How many calls, e-mails, meetings and follow-ups reps completed in the period against the target.
activities_done.formula: activities completed in the period / activity target for the period

overdue_followups.label: Overdue follow-ups
overdue_followups.definition: Scheduled activities whose due date has passed and nobody did them.
overdue_followups.formula: activities due before today with no completion date

no_next_step.label: No next step
no_next_step.definition: Open deals with no next step scheduled, or with one in the past.
no_next_step.formula: open deals with next step = empty or before today

stuck_deals.label: Stuck deals
stuck_deals.definition: Open deals that have been in their current stage much longer than usual.
stuck_deals.formula: days in current stage > {factor} × median of the stage (public tenders compared separately)

commission_payable.label: Commission payable
commission_payable.definition: Commission from invoices the client paid in the period. Commission is earned when the invoice is paid.
commission_payable.formula: Σ paid revenue × base rate × KPI coefficient of the payment month

commission_pending.label: Commission pending
commission_pending.definition: Commission from won deals that are not paid yet (not invoiced or unpaid).
commission_pending.formula: Σ (not invoiced + unpaid amount) × base rate × current KPI coefficient

renewal_rate.label: Renewal rate
renewal_rate.definition: Share of annual contracts that ended in the last {months} months and were renewed.
renewal_rate.formula: renewed contracts / contracts ending in the last {months} months

tender_win_rate.label: Tender win rate
tender_win_rate.definition: Share of won public tenders among all decided ones.

unmatched_payments.label: Unmatched payments
unmatched_payments.definition: Bank payments that cannot be matched to an invoice automatically (wrong variable symbol).
unmatched_payments.formula: number of bank payments with no matched invoice

Kontakt.Bez odezvy: Tighten lead qualification and use a sequence of 3 touches within 10 days.
Kontakt.default: Review the lead source with marketing, adjust targeting and the first-call script.

Kvalifikace.Rozpočet zmrazen: Confirm budget and spending timeline in the very first call (BANT).
Kvalifikace.default: Add a qualification checklist: decision maker, budget, timeline.

Nabídka.Cena: Offer two price options and a reference price from a similar office.
Nabídka.Vybrán konkurent: Add a competitor comparison and regional references to every proposal.
Nabídka.default: Review the proposal template with the team lead; follow up within 3 days of sending.

Vyjednávání.Cena: Negotiation coaching; discounts approved by the team lead, trade scope rather than price.
Vyjednávání.Vybrán konkurent: Team lead joins 2 meetings; strengthen the pitch with references.
Vyjednávání.default: Weekly pipeline review of deals in negotiation.

Smlouva k podpisu.Rozpočet zmrazen: Sign before quarter end and watch the client's budget measures.
Smlouva k podpisu.default: Shorten the signing path: e-signature and pre-agreed terms and conditions.
